findings.title: The90s cumulative budget is checked after work, without an owned hard-deadline supervisor
findings.evidence: Work timer aborts lifetime and closes only an already-assigned browser. startRecoveryFixture/chromium.launch are assigned after awaited startup; pending startup cannot be owned or terminated at deadline. browser.close is unbounded and fixture close uses Promise.race without cancelling the losing operation. A late/hung launch or cleanup can exceed90s; final elapsed check records overshoot only after it happens.

findings.title: Unknown CREATE outcome can retain a DB while cleanup reports success
findings.evidence: created becomes true only after CREATE reply. If database creation commits but acknowledgement rejects/times out, created stays false. close reads remaining rows but only throws if connections or created; remaining=[ownedName],connections=0,created=false is reported errors[].
findings.requested: Track attempted/confirmed/marker ownership before CREATE; unknown acknowledgement or nonempty remaining must always make cleanup incomplete. Do not infer authorization to drop from name alone; preserve exact owned facts for operator recovery.
